Replace fields of a Temporal value

Source: R/temporal.R, R/duration.R, R/plain-date-time.R, and 5 more
temporal_with.Rd

temporal_with() is Temporal's with(): it returns a copy of x with the named fields replaced and the rest kept, resolving the result with overflow. temporal_with_plain_time() is withPlainTime(), temporal_with_time_zone() is withTimeZone() (the same instant read in another zone), and temporal_with_calendar() is withCalendar(), which accepts only "iso8601" in this version.

Usage

temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_duration'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date_time'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date_time'
temporal_with_plain_time(x, time = NULL)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date_time'
temporal_with_calendar(x, calendar)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_date'
temporal_with_calendar(x, calendar)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_month_day'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_time'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_plain_year_month'
temporal_with(x, ..., overflow = "constrain")

temporal_with_plain_time(x, time = NULL)

temporal_with_calendar(x, calendar)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_zoned_date_time'
temporal_with(
  x,
  ...,
  disambiguation = "compatible",
  offset = "prefer",
  overflow = "constrain"
)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_zoned_date_time'
temporal_with_plain_time(x, time = NULL)

temporal_with_time_zone(x, time_zone)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_zoned_date_time'
temporal_with_time_zone(x, time_zone)

# S3 method for class 'zutempo_zoned_date_time'
temporal_with_calendar(x, calendar)

Arguments

x

A zutempo value.

...

Fields to replace, named: year, month, month_code, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond, microsecond, nanosecond, as the type allows, and offset_string for a zoned_date_time(). At least one is required. Giving month or month_code discards the other from x; giving both requires them to agree.

overflow

"constrain" (the default) clamps out-of-range fields, "reject" raises a zutempo_range_error for them. A duration() has nothing to clamp: the value is checked and has no effect.

time

A plain_time(), a string a plain_time() reads, or NULL for midnight.

calendar

A calendar identifier; only "iso8601" is supported.

disambiguation, offset

For a zoned_date_time(): how to resolve the new local time, as for zoned_date_time(); offset defaults to "prefer" here.

time_zone

For temporal_with_time_zone(): the new zone of each value, recycled.

Value

A value of the same class as x.

Examples

temporal_with(plain_date("2026-01-31"), month = 2)
#> <zutempo_plain_date[1]>
#> [1] 2026-02-28
try(temporal_with(plain_date("2026-01-31"), month = 2, overflow = "reject"))
#> Error : 2026-02-31 is not a valid date (element 1)
temporal_with_plain_time(plain_date_time("2026-01-31T12:00"), "08:30")
#> <zutempo_plain_date_time[1]>
#> [1] 2026-01-31T08:30:00
